prompt_en: A candid full-body photograph of an adult on a sunlit plaza gathering the edge of a building's shadow into a shallow, suspended pleat. The person stands with both feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly flexed, and hips above the midpoint of their stance. Their relaxed shoulders and bent elbows bring both hands to waist height; thumbs and fingertips pinch two nearby points on the same dark edge. The gathered shadow behaves as a thin matte layer, connected without a break to the broad shadow lying across the paving. A narrow air gap and soft self-shadow beneath the pleat reveal its depth. Seen from the illuminated side, both arms, all contact points, and the attached boundary remain distinct. A narrow strip of sunlit paving directly beneath the held pleat remains inside the frame, letting the empty gap lead the eye back toward the fingertips.
negative_en: 3D render look, impossible perspective, warped walls, over-processed retouching, illustration look, broken window geometry, low resolution, cartoon style, fake-looking background, excessive HDR

review.summary: Rechecked the complete final prompt: only the framing margin below the existing pleat changes. The same body ownership, joint reach, grounded stance, two pinch contacts and attached shadow are preserved.
